method: Independent Python standard-library parsing of final public GLB files and local provenance cross-check; no source changes, browser, server, provider or model invocation.
checks: GLB 2 header magic, version, exact file length, aligned JSON/BIN chunks
Single embedded buffer and every bufferView/accessor in bounds
All float accessors contain finite values; sparse target indices/values are bounds-checked and fully decoded
All images embedded with supported MIME; no external buffer/image URI
Every mesh has skin plus POSITION/NORMAL/JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 attributes
All triangle/joint indices in range; skin weight sums within 0.002 of one
Inverse bind matrices have MAT4 type and count equal to joint count
Required authored avatarLayer values present for each supported model capability
Shoes recolor true and Outerwear avatarReplacesTops true metadata
Runtime pose bone names match after normalization
Final file size and SHA-256 match PROVENANCE.json
97 local source files match recorded sizes and SHA-256
Recorded generation script SHA-256 matches local build-avatars.py
Every actual outerwear POSITION vertex stays above the lower-leg threshold (body floor + 30% body height); final male declares removal of 8123 source pants vertices
Named OuterwearLayerFit morph target resolves to its mesh targetNames index and defaults to Basis weight zero
Morph POSITION/NORMAL deltas have base vertex counts, finite values and valid sparse accessor ranges
Only one female Body material is explicitly hidden by outerwear; unflagged skin retains head and lower-body extents
